app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.desc.source: React to files uploaded to an FTP server; the action configuration determines if the event contains the file data itself or a link to the location of the file on the local filesystem. In any case, the event indicates that the file data has already been downloaded and is available locally
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.desc.message: 對上傳至 FTP 伺服器的檔案作出回應；動作設定會決定事件是包含檔案資料本身，還是包含本機檔案系統上該檔案位置的連結。無論如何，此事件表示檔案資料已下載並可在本機使用

app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.source:
Use an atomic transfer mechanism with `local_dir` where remote files are first moved to a temporary location (specified by `tempfile_template`) and then moved to the final location when they have been fully transferred.

This ensures that files will never be read until they are fully transferred
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.message:
透過 `local_dir` 使用不可部分完成的傳輸機制，其中遠端檔案會先移至暫存位置 (由 `tempfile_template` 指定)，並在完全傳輸完成後移至最終位置。

這可確保在完全傳輸完成之前絕不會讀取檔案

app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.source: Atomic File Transfer
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.message: 不可分割檔案傳輸

app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.source: Use an atomic file transfer mechanism
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.message: 使用不可分割檔案傳輸機制

app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.source:
The number of seconds to wait before polling again after an FTP error; the error is logged at error level, and then polling continues after this delay.

Transient problems such as a network interruption or a server restart are common with FTP; a low value recovers from such problems quickly, while a high value reduces the load on a server that is failing persistently.

**NOTE**: files are not polled while this delay is in effect
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.message:
發生 FTP 錯誤後重新輪詢前要等待的秒數；錯誤會以錯誤層級記錄，然後在此延遲後繼續輪詢。

網路中斷或伺服器重新啟動等暫時性問題在 FTP 中很常見；較小的值可快速從此類問題中復原，而較大的值可減少持續失敗之伺服器的負載。

**注意**：在此延遲生效期間不會輪詢檔案

app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.source: Error Retry Delay
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.message: 錯誤重試延遲

app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.source: The delay in seconds before retrying after an FTP error
app.RlRQ.action.ZnRwLWZpbGUtZXZlbnQ.opti.message: 發生 FTP 錯誤後重試前的延遲秒數
